query_entry_edge_proof.assumptions: Original immutable literal/code bytes and valid distinct stack/data. No self modification or stack/code aliasing.
query_entry_edge_proof.reason: R7 is fixed base and R8 is fixed base+512 at the only entry comparison; unsigned base>=base+512 is false. Later iterations bypass this comparison.

scope: Full reached/final machine, RAM, FPU/banks, integer banks, MACL/MACH/GBR, register/queue/timer and command-packet comparisons. Independent copy, selection, readiness, callback, packet/history/length/maximum and frame return checks. Twelve actual native selector -> frame sequences preserve RAM/machine state. Registration remains separate.
limitations: Direct runtime command-buffer fixtures and explicit selector -> frame call boundaries do not establish natural boot scheduling or a playable frame.
The bounded host packet sink captures polygon-window SQ transfers, not GPU consumption, rendering, interrupt/status behavior, backpressure or timing. Capacity exhaustion is an explicit -4 host stop.
Inherited privileged bank-1/FD=0, MMU-off RAM, numerical and typed guard domains apply. Readiness entry edge proof excludes self-modifying code and stack/literal aliasing.
